citations.C2: `None` values from empty CSV cells raise TypeError on `float(None)`
citations.C3: Empty strings and whitespace-padded values (`" 12 "`) — `.strip()` first, treat `""` as zero or skip.
citations.C4: Malformed numerics ("N/A", "1,299.00", "$5.00") raise ValueError — strip currency/thousands separators
citations.C5: `int("3.0")` raises ValueError even though the value is a valid integer
citations.C6: Binary float accumulation loses cents on large row counts — use `decimal.Decimal` for price and total throughout.
citations.C7: Negative price or qty pass silently (refunds vs. corrupt data) — decide the policy explicitly and validate against it.
citations.C8: `float()` silently accepts `"nan"`/`"inf"` and poisons the whole total to NaN
citations.C9: Failures are all-or-nothing with no row context — catch per row and report the index plus the offending value.
